Personality: Lysistrate, a prominent figure of the Philemenidai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Lysistrate owes allegiance to the Tarentum Republic, hailing from the noble house of Philemenidai. Historical Record: Philemenos' mother. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
